##### Project general facts

Mirari Lagoon by Zoya is a masterpiece of contemporary design, boasting a serene waterfront-inspired community that showcases the perfect blend of modern architecture and nature-infused elements. This exquisite development features a limited collection of fully furnished residences, including studios, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartments, with convertible layouts that epitomize versatility and sophistication. The carefully crafted architecture creates a peaceful ambiance where expansive open spaces, an abundance of natural light, and resort-style living converge to offer a refined and relaxing lifestyle.

The project boasts an impressive array of amenities, meticulously designed to promote wellness, leisure, and outdoor living. Residents can indulge in a stunning lagoon-style swimming pool, beautifully landscaped gardens, luxurious cabanas, and meandering running tracks, all complemented by dedicated wellness and social spaces. The community's fitness facilities and inviting outdoor areas are thoughtfully designed to encourage an active and balanced lifestyle, crafting a resort-like atmosphere that makes every day feel like a luxurious getaway. The attention to detail in the amenities is a testament to the developer's commitment to providing a truly exceptional living experience.

The interiors of Mirari Lagoon by Zoya are a symphony of thoughtful design and modern aesthetics, combining functionality with elegance. The residences feature open-plan layouts, contemporary finishes, and sleek, well-integrated kitchens, ensuring seamless comfort and practicality for everyday living. High-quality materials and carefully curated furnishings come together to create a move-in-ready environment, making Mirari Lagoon an attractive choice for both end-users and discerning investors seeking a stylish and tranquil haven.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Industrial City is a thriving hub of industrial activity, strategically positioned near Al Maktoum International Airport and Jebel Ali Port, which solidifies its role as a key component of Dubai's industrial and logistics network. The area provides a unique blend of modern housing and essential amenities, catering to the needs of employees and their families. Dubai Industrial City's proximity to major highways, such as Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, ensures effortless connectivity to central areas like Downtown Dubai and Dubai Marina.

Residents of Dubai Industrial City benefit from a diverse range of nearby facilities, including shopping centers, retail outlets, restaurants, and healthcare services, all designed to provide everyday convenience. The area's calm environment and strong transport connectivity make it an attractive choice for professionals in industrial sectors who wish to stay close to their workplace while maintaining a comfortable lifestyle. The district's focus on sustainability and eco-friendly practices further enhances its reputation as a progressive community in Dubai.

Dubai Industrial City's affordable housing options, coupled with its serene ambiance and excellent transport links, make it an appealing choice for both individuals and families. The area's reputation as a hub for industrial activity is complemented by its growing range of amenities and services, which cater to the needs of its residents. As a thriving and sustainable community, Dubai Industrial City continues to evolve, offering a unique blend of industrial activity, residential living, and everyday convenience.
